title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 29. Expresses serious concern about the human rights situation in illegally occupied territories, including in EU territory, and in cases of protracted conflicts and the multiple frozen and invisible conflicts such as those in Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and calls for effective measures to prevent grave human rights abuses on the ground;
